    How this started

    Montclair Therapy Collective is a community of psychotherapists and allied professionals in and around Montclair, founded by Jen Joseph, PsyD.

    Members get to know each other at networking nights and workshops, refer to people whose work they trust, and keep this directory so neighbors can find them.
